items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Ed Polcer as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Ed was interviewed in Tarrytown, New York on October 31, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Tarrytown, and I’m quite pleased to have Ed Polcer, cornetist and one man vanguard to keep jazz and swing alive in this country.
